name: Mantles of the Dawn
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, adventurer.  You are truly revered amongst us.  I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.

Application of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways.  As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, adventurer. With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.

For the Dawn, my brother!
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, noble Champion! Have you brought the valor tokens requested of you? Once you hand them to me, I will make our various mantles available to you for purchase.
